_note: S2 s.516: "The amount of total income computed or any amount payable or refundable under this Act, shall be rounded off to the nearest multiple of ₹10 ignoring any part of a rupee consisting of paise and thereafter if such amount is not a multiple of ten, then— (a) such amount shall be increased to the next higher amount which is a multiple of ten, if the last figure in that amount is five or more; or (b) such amount shall be reduced to the next lower amount which is a multiple of ten, if the last figure is less than five". Not amended by FA 2026. Applied by Money.roundToNearestTenPerSection516; the node refuses any other step (D-076). This row: the amount payable or refundable (1961 counterpart s.288B, unamended to FA 2026, SOURCE_CHECKED for TY 2025-26 — W-050, D-076). A refund is rounded on its magnitude with the sign restored (ROUND-NEG-001, STATUS UNCLEAR). TY 2025-26 (W-052c, D-082): 1961 s.288B — "Any amount payable, and the amount of refund due" rounded as s.516. introducedBy names the 1961 Act (assent and commencement read); the substitution is in its citation from the footnote, whose Act's own date was not read. Unamended from F(No.2)A 2019 to FA 2026.
